text:
Omar (product): FYI: tomorrow 08:00 UTC we GA the Hosted Realtime Toolcall surface. This includes the new /v1/realtime/toolcall endpoint, mosaic-lite/standard/pro models, and streaming tool-calling.
Nina (eng-runtime): Heads-up on client changes: prefer new endpoint + handshake header `x-rw-realtime: v1`. We ship a 2-week compatibility shim but recommend migrating ASAP.
Dora (devex): I'll put together a 2-min migration note for the README and add examples for node/python.
Carlos (eng-sre): Rollout plan: canary us-east-1 -> 12h monitor -> eu-west-1 -> gradual global. Watchpoints: per-org active_streams, 95p stream latency, token-controller throttles.
Omar (product): Policy: GA default concurrency per-org = 200 concurrent streams. Over-quota requests will be soft-throttled; customers can request quota increases via support. Also note billing: realtime streams billed as "stream-minutes" (per-minute increments) — see pricing doc.
Maya (support): Updating support playbooks and canned replies. Adding `realtime-ga` tag for tickets and a proactive notice for top enterprise accounts.
Nina (eng-runtime): Known caveats: 1) legacy model builds may return 422 for structured tool output. 2) If realtime pool saturates, requests will fall back to async streaming with ~3-7s added latency (adaptive-fallback). Clients will see a clear fallback header.
Dora (devex): Quick validation curl: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "x-rw-realtime: v1" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-pro","tools":[{"name":"search","schema":{}}],"prompt":"find latest changelog"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/toolcall
```
Carlos (eng-sre): Alerts: create dashboard for per-org stream_count and set alert if active_streams > 110% of quota or 95p latency > 240ms. SRE will be on extended watch for 48h post-GA.
Nina (eng-runtime): Deploy started: realtime-toolcall-ga -> canary us-east-1 at 1866000600
deploy-bot: Deploy completed to canary at 1866000750
Omar (product): Customer comms: alpha wave notif sent. We'll push GA announcement post-promote and host a 30-min webinar (Q&A + migration demo) 16:00 UTC tomorrow.
Maya (support): Proactively emailing top 20 active teams with migration steps.
Dora (devex): Will publish migration guide + SDK snippets and a short screencast.
Omar (product): Thanks all. Please reply in-thread with ownership if you're updating SDKs/docs/support so we can track. :rocket:
